body.zh-TW:
不同代理需要保留提示詞多久，現在能寫進各自的代理檔頭。⟦像冰箱裡每盒剩菜各貼保存期限，reviewer 可留久一點，短任務則早點清掉，不必整台冰箱共用同一張標籤。⟧`experimental.cacheTtl` 可設為 `"5m"` 或 `"1h"`，代表提示詞快取（把已處理內容暫存起來直接用）的存活期。只有未另外設定子代理 TTL 時，這個每代理值才會生效。可複製以下片段到代理檔頭：
```
---
name: reviewer
experimental:
  cacheTtl: "1h"
---
```
body.en:
An agent can now carry its own prompt-cache lifetime in its frontmatter. ⟦It is like putting a separate use-by label on each container in a refrigerator instead of giving the entire refrigerator one date.⟧ Set `experimental.cacheTtl` to `"5m"` or `"1h"`. This per-agent value is used only when no subagent TTL setting has been configured. Copy this frontmatter example:
```
---
name: reviewer
experimental:
  cacheTtl: "1h"
---
```

items.original: Added `experimental.cacheTtl` (`"5m"` or `"1h"`) to agent frontmatter: a per-agent prompt cache TTL used when no subagent TTL setting is configured

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器可改用好認的標籤
title.en: Self-hosted runners can register a clearer label

body.zh-TW:
一排自架執行器若都只顯示主機名稱，管理時不一定看得出各自的用途。現在可用 `--client-label` 覆寫註冊標籤；不指定時仍以主機名稱為預設。直接執行：
```
claude self-hosted-runner --client-label ci-box-3
```
也能先設環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的外部設定）：
```
export SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL=ci-box-3
```
兩種寫法都會覆寫註冊標籤。⟦這像搬家紙箱不再只寫「第 N 箱」，而是標成「廚房」或「書房」；內容沒變，找箱子的人卻能從標籤直接知道用途。⟧
body.en:
A row of self-hosted runners labeled only by hostname can be hard to identify. Override the registration label with `--client-label`; hostname remains the default. Run:
```
claude self-hosted-runner --client-label ci-box-3
```
Or set the environment variable:
```
export SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL=ci-box-3
```
Both forms override the registration label. ⟦It is a moving box labeled by room instead of only “box N”: the contents do not change, but the person sorting boxes knows where it belongs.⟧

items.original: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --client-label <label>` (or `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_CLIENT_LABEL`) to override the label the runner registers with (default: hostname)

title.zh-TW: 受管設定抓不到時會說明原因
title.en: Managed-settings failures now explain themselves

body.zh-TW: 公司集中下發的設定若沒載入，使用者以前只看到結果，難以判斷從哪裡查起。⟦像大樓物業公告不只寫「服務未啟用」，還貼出是資料載入失敗，或這棟樓本來就不向該來源取件。⟧現在開機會先顯示警告；`/doctor` 與 `/status` 也會多一行診斷，說明載入失敗，或為何根本沒有抓取。後者涵蓋 Bedrock、Vertex、第三方供應商，以及自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`。這些訊息不會替你修設定，但會把排查起點直接放到畫面上。
body.en: A centrally managed setting could fail to load without giving users a useful starting point. ⟦Now the building-management notice says whether the records failed to load or whether this building never fetches from that source.⟧ Startup shows a warning, while `/doctor` and `/status` add a line explaining the load failure or why settings were not fetched. The latter covers Bedrock, Vertex, third-party providers, and a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. It is diagnosis, not an automatic repair.

items.original: Added server-managed settings diagnostics: a startup warning when the settings fail to load, and a `/doctor` and `/status` line explaining a load failure or why they weren't fetched (Bedrock/Vertex/third-party provider, custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`)

title.zh-TW: 例行環境變數不再要求核准設定
title.en: Routine managed-setting variables stop asking for approval

body.zh-TW: 管理員調整 client-side timeout、MCP startup-mode 或 stream-watchdog 的環境變數後，Claude Code 不會再跳出設定核准提示。環境變數是程式啟動時讀取的外部設定；這次原文沒有公布各自的確切變數名稱，因此不該自行猜名稱照抄。改動只縮減這幾類受管設定的確認干擾，沒有說其他設定也免核准。⟦沿用物業管理的故事，這等於例行調整空調等候時間、設備啟動方式與監看器時，不必每次再請住戶簽一張同意單。⟧
body.en: Changing the managed environment variables for client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, or stream-watchdog no longer triggers a settings-approval prompt. The changelog does not provide their exact variable names, so there is no new name to copy from this card. The exemption is limited to those categories. ⟦In the same property-management office, routine adjustments to equipment timing and monitoring no longer require a fresh resident signature.⟧

items.original: Improved managed settings: client-side timeout, MCP startup-mode, and stream-watchdog env vars no longer trigger the settings-approval prompt

title.zh-TW: 大型儲存庫推送前先提醒 workflow 權限
title.en: Web setup warns about a missing workflow scope

body.zh-TW: 用 `/web-setup` 準備 GitHub 流程時，如果 GitHub CLI token（命令列工具使用的授權令牌）缺少 `workflow` scope，畫面現在會先警告你。scope 是這張令牌被允許做的事。缺少它時，對非常大的儲存庫執行 push 可能被拒絕；原文說的是「可能」，不是每次都會失敗，也不是 `/web-setup` 會自動補權限。⟦居家水電施工前，師傅先看電表容量能不能帶動大型機具：容量不夠時，大工程可能跳電，所以先提醒你確認；他不會說工程一定做不成，也不會替你換電表。⟧
body.en: During `/web-setup`, Claude Code now warns if the GitHub CLI token lacks the `workflow` scope. Without that scope, a push to a very large repository can be rejected. This is a warning about a possible failure, not a claim that every push will fail, and `/web-setup` does not grant the scope for you. ⟦Before household electrical work, an electrician checks whether the meter capacity can run heavy equipment: insufficient capacity may trip the power during a large job, so it is a prompt to check, not a claim that the work cannot happen or an offer to replace the meter.⟧

items.original: Added a warning in `/web-setup` when the GitHub CLI token lacks the `workflow` scope, since pushes to very large repositories can be rejected without it

title.zh-TW: 企業成員可向管理員申請提高用量
title.en: Eligible enterprise members can request more usage

body.zh-TW: 企業組織的成員碰到用量上限時，多了一個清楚的申請入口：`/usage-credits` 會讓你向管理員要求提高上限。適用對象是透過 AWS Marketplace 計費、自助企業版與企業試用的組織。另一方面，限流（短時間請求太多而被暫緩）、用量與快速模式訊息，若偵測到你的組織沒有這個指令，就不再叫你執行它；例如管理員用 `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND` 隱藏時也算。⟦它像公司採購與請款窗口：符合制度的人有表可送，不提供這項流程的部門也不會收到「請去填那張不存在的表」的通知。⟧
body.en: Members of eligible Enterprise organizations can now run `/usage-credits` to ask an administrator for a higher usage limit. Eligibility covers organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials. Rate-limit, usage, and fast-mode messages also stop recommending the command when the organization does not offer it, including when `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND` hides it. ⟦It works like a company purchasing office: eligible staff get a request form, while departments without that process are not told to submit a form that does not exist.⟧

items.original:
Added `/usage-credits` for Enterprise organizations billed through AWS Marketplace, self-serve Enterprise, and Enterprise trials, so members can request a higher usage limit from their admin
Fixed rate-limit, usage, and fast-mode messages telling you to run `/usage-credits` when that command isn't available for your organization (e.g. hidden with `DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND`)

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段傳訊支援更多環境
title.en: Cross-session messaging reaches more environments

body.zh-TW: 同一台機器上的工作階段，現在可在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry，以及關閉遙測（回傳運作資料供觀察）的情況下使用 `SendMessage` 與 `ListAgents`。⟦它像辦公室桌間的氣送管：膠囊不只通往原本的桌區，新區也接上管路；預設投入口故障時，還會改走每位使用者各自私有的備用管。⟧預設 `/tmp` 無法使用時，備援位置是每位使用者私有的 `/tmp` 目錄，通知與 `/status` 會說明實際目錄，方便修正。用輸入法打出的韓文等非拉丁名稱，如今也能被其他工作階段的 @ 提及正確比對。
body.en: Sessions on the same machine can now use `SendMessage` and `ListAgents` on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled. ⟦Picture pneumatic tubes between office desks: more office sections now connect, and a broken default chute sends each person's capsules through that person's private backup tube.⟧ If the default `/tmp` cannot be used, messaging falls back to a private per-user `/tmp` directory; the notice and `/status` name it. Mentions also match non-Latin session names, including Korean entered through an IME.

items.original:
Added cross-session messaging (`SendMessage` / `ListAgents`) between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled
Improved cross-session messaging: falls back to a private per-user `/tmp` directory when the default one can't be used, and the notice and `/status` name the directory to fix
Fixed @-mentions of other sessions not matching names typed with non-Latin characters (for example Korean entered through an IME)

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息的路由與信任更嚴謹
title.en: Cross-session routes and trust become stricter

body.zh-TW: `crossSessionInbound` 若填成無效值，現在不會再靜默略過。這個鍵位於 `~/.claude/settings.json`；原文沒有列有效值，因此只能確認要改成文件所列的有效值。user settings 會先警告並暫扣跨工作階段訊息，managed settings 則警告並拒收，兩者都維持到設定修正為止。Linux 使用者命名空間裡，對未對應擁有者的 root 等效信任縮到正規系統目錄。子代理替父工作階段向別處執行 `SendMessage` 時，回覆會回到父工作階段的對話。⟦仍是桌間氣送管：錯標籤的膠囊會被暫放或退回，內部管線的認定範圍縮小，代送件的回覆則送回委託人的桌面。⟧
body.en: An invalid `crossSessionInbound` value is no longer ignored. The key lives in `~/.claude/settings.json`; the changelog lists no valid values, so choose one from the documentation. User settings warn and hold cross-session messages, while managed settings warn and refuse them, in both cases until fixed. In Linux user namespaces, root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories. A reply to a subagent's `SendMessage` goes to the parent session conversation. ⟦The office tubes now hold or return a capsule with a bad route label, narrow what counts as internal pipework, and return a delegated reply to the sender's own desk.⟧

items.original:
Fixed an invalid `crossSessionInbound` value being silently ignored: it now warns and holds cross-session messages (user settings) or refuses them (managed settings) until fixed
Changed cross-session messaging in Linux user namespaces: root-equivalent trust for unmapped owners is limited to canonical system directories
Changed `SendMessage` from a subagent to another session: the result now notes that any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to the subagent

title.zh-TW: 代理看板不再復活舊工作或重複開工
title.en: Agent view stops reviving or duplicating old work

body.zh-TW: 背景工作隔著關機再回來，最需要的是看清它真正停在哪。⟦工作坊的工單看板現在照實把數週前的工單標在停工點；要重開會先問，而不是工坊一開門就讓舊機器自行轉起來。⟧新建工作階段也不再誤開較舊的對話，或吞掉你剛打的提示。若一個已停止的工作階段早已在另一個終端機接續，再從 `claude agents` 打開不會啟動第二個行程；該列會直接說它已在某個終端機開啟。
body.en: After a machine wakes, you need to know where background work really stopped. ⟦The workshop job board now leaves a weeks-old ticket at its true stopping point and asks before restarting it, instead of powering old machinery as soon as the shop opens.⟧ A new session no longer opens an older conversation or drops the prompt you typed. Opening a stopped session already resumed in another terminal does not start a second process; its `claude agents` row says it is open in a terminal.

items.original:
Fixed agent view resurrecting a weeks-old background session after the machine was off: such a session now shows as stopped at its real end, and opening it asks before resuming its saved conversation
Fixed agent view sometimes opening an older conversation, and dropping the typed prompt, when starting a new session
Fixed `claude agents`: opening a stopped session that you already resumed in another terminal no longer starts a second process on that conversation; the row now says it is open in a terminal

title.zh-TW: 代理看板的鍵盤與按鍵分工恢復正常
title.en: Agent board keyboard input and key roles work again

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 從工作階段卸離後，或終端機分頁仍留在 win32-input-mode 時，`claude agents` 清單不再對鍵盤沒反應。派工輸入框的按鍵也分清工作：shift+enter 插入換行，ctrl+enter 才會派工並附加。⟦同一座工作坊的工單看板上，卸下工單或換到特殊書寫模式後，筆仍能在清單上劃記；寫到下一行與把工單送去處理，也各有自己的按鍵。⟧
body.en: On Windows, the `claude agents` list responds to the keyboard again after detaching from a session or when launched in a terminal tab left in win32-input-mode. The dispatch input also gives its keys distinct jobs: shift+enter inserts a newline, while ctrl+enter dispatches and attaches. ⟦On the same workshop job board, the pen still marks the list after detaching a job or entering a special writing mode; starting a new line and sending the job onward each have their own key.⟧

items.original:
Windows: Fixed the `claude agents` list not responding to the keyboard after detaching from a session, or when launched in a terminal tab left in win32-input-mode
Changed shift+enter in the agent view dispatch input to insert a newline (matching the prompt); ctrl+enter now dispatches and attaches

title.zh-TW: 代理看板啟動時的信任與資料防護補好
title.en: Agent board startup keeps its trust check and survives bad data

body.zh-TW: 打開 `claude agents` 時，該問的工作區信任提示不會因設定了 `CI` 環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的設定值）就被跳過。PR 狀態快取（把查過的合併請求結果暫存起來）混入損壞資料時，啟動也不再崩潰。⟦同一座工作坊的工單看板前，值班人員仍會要求你先確認能否使用工作區；即使收納盒混進一張損壞工單，也不會讓整塊看板在開門時倒下。⟧
body.en: When `claude agents` opens, setting the `CI` environment variable no longer skips the workspace trust prompt. A malformed entry in the PR-status cache also no longer crashes launch. ⟦At the same workshop job board, the attendant still asks you to confirm use of the workspace; even a damaged ticket mixed into the tray does not make the whole board collapse when the door opens.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude agents` skipping the workspace trust prompt when the `CI` environment variable is set
Fixed `claude agents` crashing on launch when the PR-status cache held a malformed entry

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤答錯不再讓背景工作乾等
title.en: Bad hook output no longer leaves agents waiting

body.zh-TW: 背景工作階段卡住不動時，原因若是 `PermissionRequest` 或 `PreToolUse` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）印出無效答案，`claude agents` 現在會直接列出掛鉤名稱與 schema error。schema error 是回覆結構不符規格。掛鉤 stdout（程式的一般文字輸出）若印出看似物件的 `{…}`，卻不是合法 JSON，也不再被當成普通文字略過，而會回報掛鉤錯誤與解析訊息。⟦如同收件櫃檯看不懂表單時，退回並標出哪一欄格式錯，而不是把表單壓在桌下，讓申請人永遠等不到消息。⟧
body.en: A background session no longer waits silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer. Its `claude agents` row names the hook and schema error. If hook stdout prints a `{…}` object that is not valid JSON, it is no longer accepted as plain text; Claude Code reports a hook error with the parse message. ⟦An intake clerk now returns an unreadable form with the bad field marked instead of placing it under the desk while the applicant waits forever.⟧

items.original:
Fixed background sessions waiting silently when a `PermissionRequest` or `PreToolUse` hook prints an invalid answer: the `claude agents` row now names the hook and the schema error
Fixed hooks silently treating a stdout `{…}` object that isn't valid JSON as plain text; it's now reported as a hook error with the parse message

title.zh-TW: 背景工作樹不再被誤刪或誤判
title.en: Active worktrees stop being removed or misjudged

body.zh-TW: 工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）分支若已併入你簽出的預設分支，例如本機 `main`，即使還沒 push，`claude agents` 與 `claude rm` 也不會再以「有提交尚未推送」拒絕刪除。反過來，仍在執行的背景工作階段會持有工作樹的鎖。清理程序與 `git worktree remove` 會略過它，不會讓工作中的代理突然失去簽出內容。⟦這像共用熱座位的個人置物櫃：物品已歸檔就能正常清櫃，仍有人使用時則掛上鎖，清潔人員不會誤收。⟧
body.en: If a worktree branch is already merged into the checked-out default branch, such as local `main`, `claude agents` and `claude rm` no longer refuse deletion merely because that merge has not been pushed. Meanwhile, a running background session holds its worktree lock. Cleanup and `git worktree remove` leave it alone instead of taking away its checkout. ⟦A shared-office locker can be cleared after its contents are filed, but remains locked while its owner is still using the desk.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to delete a session ("has commits that are not pushed anywhere") when its worktree branch was already merged into your checked-out default branch (e.g. local `main`) but not yet pushed
Fixed a backgrounded worktree session losing its checkout: the background session now holds the worktree's lock while it runs, so cleanup and `git worktree remove` leave it alone

title.zh-TW: token 更新鎖碰撞時改成可重試
title.en: Token-refresh contention becomes retryable

body.zh-TW: 另一個 Claude Code 行程正在更新 token（用來證明登入狀態的授權令牌），剛好你的工作階段 token 又過期時，過去會直接把你送回登入畫面。⟦電話總機遇到線路佔用，現在會給可重撥的佔線音，而不是把整通電話掛斷、叫你重新辦一次通話身分。⟧修正後，這次請求會以可重試的錯誤失敗。它沒有說請求會自動成功，也沒有改變登入方式；差別是短暫的更新鎖衝突不再被誤當成你需要重新登入。
body.en: If another Claude Code process holds the token-refresh lock just as the current session token expires, you are no longer sent to the login screen. ⟦The telephone exchange now returns a busy tone that invites a redial instead of disconnecting the call and making you establish your identity again.⟧ The request fails with a retryable error. It is still a failed request, not a promise of automatic success; the temporary lock conflict is simply no longer mistaken for a lost login.

items.original: Fixed being sent to the login screen when another Claude Code process held the token refresh lock while the session token had expired; the request now fails with a retryable error instead

title.zh-TW: 主控台登入不可用時改走 API 金鑰
title.en: Login falls back to an API key when Console sign-in cannot work

body.zh-TW: 有些機器已設定 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`，或使用 API 金鑰輔助程式，因此無法採用 `/login` 建議的 Console 登入。以前流程還沒顯示登入網址，就先以 OAuth 錯誤中止。現在 `/login` 會改走 API 金鑰登入，讓既有憑證來源能接手。這是登入方式的備援，不是上一張 token 更新鎖的重試機制。⟦沿用電話總機的故事：指定分機打不通時，接線生改接另一條已有線路，而不是在播出號碼前就結束通話。⟧
body.en: Some machines cannot use the recommended Console sign-in because `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an API-key helper is set. `/login` used to stop with an OAuth error before even showing the sign-in URL. It now falls back to API-key sign-in and uses the credential path already available. This is a login-method fallback, separate from retrying token-refresh contention. ⟦At the telephone exchange, the operator connects an available line when the preferred extension cannot work instead of ending the call before reading the number.⟧

items.original: Fixed the recommended Console sign-in in `/login` failing with an OAuth error before showing a sign-in URL on machines where it can't be used (for example when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or an API key helper is set); it now falls back to the API-key sign-in

title.zh-TW: Claude apps 閘道登入與模型探索不再卡住
title.en: Claude apps gateway login and discovery stop stalling

body.zh-TW:
連上 Claude apps 閘道時，若流程需要受管設定的安全核准對話框，`/login` 不會再卡住。另一種情況是 `apiKeyHelper` 成為唯一憑證來源；過去即使開啟閘道模型探索，探索也完全不執行，現在已能運作。原文點名的環境變數是：
```
CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY
```
這個環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的外部設定）只控制原文所說的模型探索。⟦電話總機遇到核准步驟不再讓來電停在保留音；只留下助理分機作為聯絡方式時，也仍會循線找出可用分機。⟧
body.en:
`/login` no longer hangs when connecting to a Claude apps gateway requires the managed-settings security-approval dialog. Gateway model discovery also runs when `apiKeyHelper` is the only credential source. The environment variable named in the changelog is:
```
CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY
```
⟦The telephone exchange no longer leaves a caller on hold at an approval step, and it can still find available extensions when the assistant's line is the only contact route.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/login` to a Claude apps gateway hanging when the managed-settings security approval dialog was required
Fixed gateway model discovery (`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`) never running when `apiKeyHelper` is the only credential

title.zh-TW: MCP 項目照真實範圍歸類
title.en: MCP entries now follow their real scope

body.zh-TW: MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）項目現在會按真實範圍顯示。專案 `.mcp.json` 中宣告 claude.ai connector type 的項目，不再列在受信任的「claude.ai」標題下，而會出現在真正範圍。型別宣告不會改變它的歸類。⟦超市補貨時，貨會照真實走道標籤上架，不因外箱印著「主打」就擺到促銷區。⟧
body.en: MCP entries now appear under their real scope. A project `.mcp.json` entry declaring the claude.ai connector type no longer appears under the trusted “claude.ai” heading. That type declaration does not change its classification. ⟦When restocking a supermarket, goods go on the aisle named by their real label, not into the promotion section because the box says “featured.”⟧

items.original: Fixed `/mcp` listing a project `.mcp.json` entry that declares the claude.ai connector type under the trusted "claude.ai" heading; it now appears under its real scope

title.zh-TW: MCP 授權標頭遇 401 會照文件重試
title.en: MCP authorization headers now retry as documented

body.zh-TW: MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）server 的 `headersHelper` 若提供 `Authorization` header，遇到 401 時，現在會照文件重跑 helper 並重試呼叫，不再落入 OAuth discovery。⟦自動販賣機把投入的硬幣退回時，會重新讀取那枚硬幣，讓你再按一次；不會鎖住要你改綁別的付款方式。⟧
body.en: When an MCP server’s `headersHelper` supplies the `Authorization` header and gets a 401, Claude Code now reruns the helper and retries the call as documented instead of entering OAuth discovery. ⟦When a vending machine returns your coin, it reads that coin again and lets you press the button once more; it does not lock up and demand that you link a different payment method.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP servers whose `headersHelper` supplies the `Authorization` header falling into OAuth discovery on a 401 instead of re-running the helper and retrying the call as documented

title.zh-TW: 桌面工作階段不再一到清理期就消失
title.en: Desktop sessions survive routine transcript cleanup

body.zh-TW:
你在 Claude Desktop 或 Cowork 開的工作階段，只要應用程式裡還留著，它的逐字稿就不會再因為例行清理而在 30 天後被刪掉。如果你的組織有自己的保留規則，仍照組織的走。想給這個「不刪」設一個期限，就到 `~/.claude/settings.json` 加一行，數字換成你要保留的天數（範例是 30）：
```
{"desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays": 30}
```
⟦像博物館庫房定期清點時，正在展廳裡的展品先不列入下架清單；但館方仍可訂一條規矩，這種展品最多留展多久就要收回。⟧
body.en:
A session you opened in Claude Desktop or Cowork keeps its transcript as long as the app still holds it; routine cleanup no longer deletes it after 30 days. An organization retention rule, if you have one, still wins. To put a limit on that keep-alive, add one line to `~/.claude/settings.json` and change the number to the days you want (30 is the example):
```
{"desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays": 30}
```
⟦During a museum's routine stock-take, pieces currently on display are left off the removal list; the museum can still rule how many days such a piece may stay on show before it goes back.⟧

items.original: Fixed Claude Desktop and Cowork sessions disappearing after 30 days: the transcript cleanup now keeps desktop-written sessions while they are in the app (unless org policy manages retention); the new `desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays` setting caps the exemption

title.zh-TW: 查看日誌結束後終端機會恢復原狀
title.en: Claude logs restores terminal modes on exit

body.zh-TW: 跑完 `claude logs` 回到原本的終端機後，滑鼠操作或貼上方式不該還像停留在日誌介面。這次修正會在離開時關掉三種先前殘留的模式：mouse tracking、bracketed paste，以及 alternate screen。它們分別影響滑鼠事件、貼上內容的邊界標記與終端機使用的替代畫面。修正只保證 `claude logs` 不再把這些模式留著，沒有改你的其他終端機設定。⟦像借用工作檯時，暫時開了跟手移動的工作燈、替送來的材料加上起迄標籤，並鋪上一層暫用檯面；離開前逐一關燈、取下標籤、收起檯面，讓原本的工作檯恢復原狀。⟧
body.en: After `claude logs` exits, its terminal should no longer behave as if the log viewer were still open. Claude Code now switches off mouse tracking, bracketed paste, and the alternate screen in the terminal where the command ran. The fix concerns modes enabled by `claude logs`; it does not claim to replace other terminal preferences. ⟦When borrowing a workbench, you may temporarily turn on a hand-following task light, label delivered materials with start and end markers, and lay down a temporary work surface; before leaving, switch off the light, remove the labels, and put away the surface so the bench is restored.⟧

items.original: Fixed `claude logs` leaving mouse tracking, bracketed paste and the alternate screen switched on in the terminal it was run from

title.zh-TW: 終端機文字照原字排版且對齊
title.en: Terminal text renders literally and lines up

body.zh-TW: 終端機裡幾個看似小問題，都指向同一件事：文字應照原字顯示，欄位也該站在正確位置。⟦招牌印刷店拿到什麼字就排什麼字，emoji 不從中間裁斷，每一行也對準同一條格線；現在畫面照這套原則修正。⟧`/model` 與快速模式切換通知中的模型名稱改用程式碼樣式，因此 `[1m]` 這類字尾會按字面顯示，不再變連結。信任對話框的儲存庫權限規則很長時，不再因從 emoji 中間截斷而出現亂碼。開機警告也不再比其餘逐字稿右移一欄。
body.en: Several terminal glitches had one theme: text should remain literal and columns should align. ⟦A sign printer now prints the supplied characters, never slices an emoji through its middle, and places every line on the same grid.⟧ Model names in `/model` and fast-mode notices render as code, so a suffix such as `[1m]` stays literal instead of becoming a link. Long repository-permission rules no longer show a garbled character when truncated inside an emoji. Startup warnings also align with the rest of the transcript instead of shifting one column right.

items.original:
Fixed model names in `/model` and fast-mode switch notices to render as code, so suffixes like `[1m]` display literally instead of as a link
Fixed the trust dialog's list of repo permission rules showing a garbled character when a long rule was cut off in the middle of an emoji
Fixed startup warnings (e.g. "N MCP servers need authentication") rendering one column right of the rest of the transcript

title.zh-TW: 權限模式指示器不再被退出提示遮住
title.en: Permission mode stays visible after Ctrl-C

body.zh-TW: 你按下 ctrl+c，接著立刻按 shift+tab 切換權限模式時，畫面會同時需要顯示退出提醒與權限狀態。以前「Press Ctrl-C again to exit」提示會蓋住權限模式指示器，讓人無法確認剛才是否切換成功。現在兩者不再互相遮擋；修正的是這個緊接按鍵的顯示順序，沒有改 ctrl+c 或 shift+tab 本身的功能。⟦這像汽車儀表板的警示燈不再被臨時貼上的提醒紙蓋住：提醒仍在，但駕駛也能看見目前模式。⟧
body.en: Pressing shift+tab immediately after ctrl+c used to leave the permission-mode indicator hidden behind “Press Ctrl-C again to exit.” The indicator now remains visible, so you can see the selected mode while the exit hint is present. The fix changes this display overlap, not what ctrl+c or shift+tab does. ⟦It is a car dashboard where a temporary reminder note no longer covers a warning lamp: both the reminder and the current mode remain readable.⟧

items.original: Fixed the permission mode indicator staying hidden behind the "Press Ctrl-C again to exit" hint when you press shift+tab right after ctrl+c

title.zh-TW: 敏感檔案的暫存副本不再上雲
title.en: Temporary copies of sensitive files stay local

body.zh-TW: 用 `/ultrareview` 或從本機播種雲端工作階段時，未提交修改可能藏在編輯器自動留下的暫存、臨時或備份副本。現在 `prod.env` 類檔案、`*.tfvars`，以及憑證檔的這些副本都不會上傳，例如 `key.pem.tmp`、`id_rsa.swo`；修改會留在你的機器上。這項修正鎖定的是這些敏感檔案及其副本，不代表所有未提交檔案一律不上傳。⟦寄出一疊工作文件前，先把機密頁和影印時留下的副本收回保險箱，只讓可寄的內容離開辦公室。⟧
body.en: `/ultrareview` and locally seeded cloud sessions no longer upload uncommitted edits hidden in swap, temporary, or backup copies of sensitive files. This covers `prod.env`-style files, `*.tfvars`, and credential-file copies such as `key.pem.tmp` and `id_rsa.swo`; they stay on your machine. The statement is specific to these files, not every uncommitted edit. ⟦Before sending a stack of work papers, the confidential pages and their copier leftovers go back into the safe, while only approved pages leave the office.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/ultrareview` and locally seeded cloud sessions uploading uncommitted edits to `prod.env`-style and `*.tfvars` files, or to editor swap, temp, and backup copies of credential files (e.g. `key.pem.tmp`, `id_rsa.swo`); they now stay on your machine

title.zh-TW: Ultrareview 啟動前先查 GitHub 存取權
title.en: Ultrareview checks repository access before launch

body.zh-TW: 準備執行 `/ultrareview <PR#>` 時，Claude Code 會先確認與 Claude 帳號連結的 GitHub 帳號能否存取該儲存庫。若權限不符，畫面會在啟動前說明如何修正，不必等雲端工作階段建立後才失敗。檢查的是「已連結的 GitHub 帳號」與目標儲存庫之間的存取關係；不是只看你本機目前登入哪個帳號。⟦這像訂會議室前先確認會員資格是否涵蓋那一間，若不涵蓋就先告訴你怎麼補，而不是等所有人抵達才宣布不能使用。⟧
body.en: Before `/ultrareview <PR#>` launches, Claude Code checks whether the GitHub account connected to your Claude account can access the repository. If not, it explains how to fix the connection before creating the cloud session instead of failing afterward. The check concerns the linked account's repository access. ⟦It is checking whether a membership covers a particular meeting room before booking it, then explaining how to fix the membership before the group arrives.⟧

items.original: Improved `/ultrareview <PR#>` to check before launch that the GitHub account connected to your Claude account can access the repository, and to explain how to fix it, instead of failing after the cloud session starts

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 重連後補回最新畫面
title.en: Remote Control catches up after reconnecting

body.zh-TW: Remote Control 工作階段在 CLI 靜默重連後，連線裝置偶爾會停在舊畫面：該出現的權限提示沒來，最新訊息也看不到。⟦這像電梯樓層面板短暫斷線又接回後，會補亮已按下的樓層並顯示最新行程，而不是讓乘客對著過時的燈號猜電梯要去哪。⟧這個偶發同步問題已修正，裝置會重新看到權限提示與最新訊息。修正針對 CLI 靜默重連後的顯示缺漏，原文沒有宣稱所有 Remote Control 連線問題都因此解決。
body.en: After the CLI silently reconnected a Remote Control session, a connected device could remain on stale state: no permission prompt and no latest messages. ⟦An elevator panel now restores the pressed-floor lights and current trip after a brief reconnection instead of making riders infer the destination from an old display.⟧ That occasional catch-up failure is fixed. The scope is the missing prompt and messages after silent CLI reconnection, not every possible Remote Control connection problem.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control sessions occasionally never showing a permission prompt or the latest messages on the connected device after the CLI silently reconnected

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 前方有全域旗標也能讀參數
title.en: Remote Control accepts its flags after global options

body.zh-TW: 包裝程式有時會在 `claude remote-control` 子命令前插入選項，使用者也可能先放全域旗標。過去只要前方多了這些內容，子命令自己的 `--spawn`、`--name` 等旗標就可能被拒絕。現在解析順序已修正，前面的全域旗標或包裝程式注入選項，不會妨礙 remote-control 讀取自己的旗標。⟦延續電梯面板：前一位乘客先按了樓層，不會讓面板拒絕你接著按的樓層；先後輸入都能落到各自該控制的部分。⟧
body.en: A wrapper may inject an option before the `claude remote-control` subcommand, and users may place a global flag there too. That prefix used to make remote-control reject its own flags, including `--spawn` and `--name`. The parser now accepts those flags despite the preceding options. ⟦On the same elevator panel, a floor pressed before yours no longer causes the panel to reject your button; each input still reaches its own control.⟧

items.original: Fixed `claude remote-control` rejecting its own flags (e.g. `--spawn`, `--name`) when a global flag or a wrapper-injected option precedes the subcommand

title.zh-TW: 容器憑證尚未可讀時雲端工作不再失敗
title.en: Cloud sessions tolerate credentials that are still becoming readable

body.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段啟動時，容器裡的工作階段憑證可能還處於讀不到的短暫過渡期。以前偶爾會因此直接啟動失敗；現在流程會處理這段先後差，避免把「憑證尚未可讀」當成最終失敗。原文只說修正啟動時的偶發問題，沒有公布等待多久、重試幾次，也沒有表示無效憑證會被接受。⟦碼頭裝卸時，貨物還吊在吊臂上、尚未完成交接，作業隊不會當成沒送到，等貨落地再接手；它處理的是交付時間差，不是把未到貨物算成已入庫。⟧
body.en: A cloud session could occasionally fail at startup because its container's session credentials were not readable yet. Startup now handles that transition instead of treating “not readable yet” as a final failure. The changelog gives no wait duration or retry count, and does not say invalid credentials are accepted. ⟦At a dock, cargo still hanging from the crane has not been handed over yet; the crew does not count it as undelivered and takes it once it lands, managing the timing gap without recording undelivered cargo as stored.⟧

items.original: Fixed cloud sessions occasionally failing at startup when the container's session credentials were not yet readable

title.zh-TW: VSCode 找不到舊對話就直接開新的
title.en: VS Code opens a new chat when no saved conversation exists

body.zh-TW: VSCode 聊天分頁若對應的工作階段從未存檔，本來沒有舊對話可載入，卻會一直卡在「No conversation found」。現在遇到這個條件，分頁會直接建立新對話，讓你可以開始輸入。修正只針對「從未存檔」的工作階段，不是把遺失的歷史內容找回來；畫面也不會再停在一個無法前進的錯誤狀態。⟦這像繪圖軟體找不到任何既有存檔時，直接給你一張新畫布，而不是反覆顯示找不到舊畫，卻連新作品也不讓開始。⟧
body.en: A VS Code chat tab could become stuck on “No conversation found” when its session had never been saved, meaning there was no old conversation to load. It now starts a new conversation so you can type. This does not recover missing history; it handles the specific never-saved state. ⟦A drawing app that finds no saved artwork opens a blank canvas instead of repeating that the old picture is missing while refusing to let a new one begin.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Fixed a chat tab getting stuck on "No conversation found" when its session was never saved; it now starts a new conversation instead

title.zh-TW: Workflow 工具說明大幅瘦身
title.en: Workflow's built-in prompt becomes much smaller

body.zh-TW: Workflow 工具每次出場，都會把自己的說明帶進提示詞。⟦現在像把隨身操作卡從厚手冊精簡成一張重點卡，約 5.7k token 的內容降到約 1k；需要寫腳本時，再拉開抽屜讀隨附的 `workflow-authoring` 技能。⟧token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）占用因此變小，而腳本撰寫參考資料沒有消失，只是移到技能裡。這項改進講的是 Workflow 工具的提示詞占用，不是工作流程執行速度或輸出品質的數字保證。
body.en: The Workflow tool carries its description in the prompt whenever it is available. ⟦Its pocket instruction card has been cut from about 5.7k tokens to about 1k, while the detailed script-writing manual now sits in the bundled `workflow-authoring` skill.⟧ The reference material was moved, not removed. This change reduces prompt footprint; the changelog makes no numerical promise about execution speed or output quality.

items.original: Improved the Workflow tool's prompt footprint: its description is now about 1k tokens instead of 5.7k, with the script-writing reference moved into a bundled `workflow-authoring` skill

title.zh-TW: PR 沒變時少查 GitHub，有動作就刷新
title.en: The PR badge polls less until the PR changes

body.zh-TW: 提示列上的 PR 徽章需要向 GitHub 查狀態，但合併請求沒有變動時，反覆查同一答案只會增加請求。現在未變動期間會降低檢查頻率；一旦你 push，或執行 `gh pr` 指令，徽章仍會立刻刷新。這不是取消自動檢查，也不是讓所有更新都延後，而是把明確會改變 PR 的動作保留為即時觸發點。⟦園丁不再頻繁量同一株毫無變化的幼苗；澆水或修剪後卻會立刻再量，因此少做重複紀錄，也不漏掉剛發生的變化。⟧
body.en: The prompt-footer PR badge now checks GitHub less often while its pull request remains unchanged. A push or any `gh pr` command still refreshes it immediately. Automatic checking has not disappeared; explicit actions that can change the PR remain immediate triggers. ⟦A gardener stops repeatedly measuring an unchanged seedling, but measures again right after watering or pruning, avoiding duplicate notes without missing a fresh change.⟧

items.original: Improved the prompt-footer PR badge to check GitHub less often while the pull request is unchanged; a push or a `gh pr` command still refreshes it right away

title.zh-TW: Loop 的自由節奏模式全面可用
title.en: Loop's flexible pacing works across providers

body.zh-TW: `/loop` 現在不必因模型供應環境不同而少一種運作方式。⟦節拍器的自由速度模式如今能配每種樂器：演奏者可自己調節拍，也能讓樂器在沒有提示時按預設節奏繼續，不再因換了演奏平台就少掉選項。⟧自訂節奏的動態模式與不帶提示的自主預設，現在一律可用，也包含 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry。這項變更是把既有模式的可用範圍拉齊；原文沒有新增其他 `/loop` 模式，也沒有指定哪一種節奏較快。
body.en: `/loop` no longer loses an operating style because of the model provider. ⟦The metronome's free-tempo setting now works with every instrument: the player may set the pace, or the instrument may continue at its autonomous default without a prompt, even after moving to another performance setup.⟧ Self-paced dynamic mode and the no-prompt autonomous default are always available, including on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry. This expands existing modes; it does not add another mode or declare one faster.

items.original: Changed `/loop`: self-paced dynamic mode and the no-prompt autonomous default are now always available, including on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry

title.zh-TW: Anthropic 遙測錯誤不再冒充 OTel 問題
title.en: Anthropic telemetry errors identify their real source

body.zh-TW: 看到 `[3P telemetry] OTEL diag error`，維運人員很容易以為自己的 OTel collector（集中收集運作資料的服務）壞了，但失敗可能來自 Anthropic 自己的遙測匯出。現在這類失敗改在 debug 層級記成 `[Anthropic telemetry]`，來源與嚴重度都更貼近實況。它沒有修復匯出失敗本身，而是避免把責任指向使用者的 OTel collector。⟦廠內廣播把自家設備雜訊標成內部訊息，不再混進外部警報頻道；維修人員便不會跑去拆一台其實正常的外接警報器。⟧
body.en: `[3P telemetry] OTEL diag error` could make operators suspect their own OTel collector even when Anthropic's telemetry export had failed. These failures now log at debug level as `[Anthropic telemetry]`, identifying the source and lowering the apparent severity. The export failure itself is not claimed to be fixed; the message no longer blames the user's collector. ⟦A factory announcement labels noise from its own equipment as internal instead of mixing it with external alarms, so technicians do not dismantle a healthy outside alarm.⟧

items.original: Changed Anthropic telemetry export failures to log at debug level as `[Anthropic telemetry]` instead of `[3P telemetry] OTEL diag error`, so they are not mistaken for your OTel collector failing

entries: Added the `SendFeedback` tool: when something goes wrong in a session, Claude can draft a feedback report for you to review and send from `/feedback` (turn off with the `feedbackDrafts` setting)
Added `{id, text, cooldownSessions, priority}` entries, `tipsFile`, and `label` to `spinnerTipsOverride`, so organizations can rotate their own tips alongside the built-in ones
Added a tip on Bash permission prompts pointing to auto mode, with a one-keystroke "Yes, and switch to auto mode" option
Added `/claude-api cost-optimize` to profile an existing project's Claude API spend and work through cost levers (caching, token hygiene, batch, effort, model choice) one measured change at a time
Updated the `/claude-api` skill with Admin API coverage (organization members, invites, workspaces, API keys, rate limit reports, workload identity federation, CMEK)
Fixed fast arrow-key + Enter sequences acting on the row above the one you navigated to in history search, `/config`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, background tasks, and `/model`
Fixed sub-agents dying on a first-call model 404: they now use the session's fallback model chain, and the error returned to the parent includes the error type, status, request id, and model
Fixed a hook or background agent that printed megabytes of error output being able to overflow the conversation and wedge the session on "Prompt is too long"
Fixed Ctrl keyboard shortcuts not firing under non-Latin (e.g. Cyrillic) keyboard layouts in kitty-protocol terminals
Fixed text like `<35;150;7M` being inserted into the prompt when a mouse report arrived split across reads right after the escape prefix
Fixed the Bash sandbox's after-command cleanup deleting a dotfile-managed `~/.claude/settings.json` symlink (nix/home-manager, stow) when it is repointed outside the sandbox's writable area
Fixed `/terminal-setup` overwriting your entire Zed `keymap.json` instead of merging in its keybinding
Fixed `/rename` silently confirming when the session registry could not be updated; it now says other sessions may still show the old name
Fixed `/compact` and "Summarize from here" in sessions started with `--agent` summarizing under the default system prompt instead of the conversation's own
Fixed a background session showing "opening…" forever in `claude agents` after its terminal host process died; the row now fails within seconds with the reason, and Enter restarts it
Fixed unbounded memory growth when a hook's or background task's output file could not be written; the file now notes where output was lost
Fixed `/install-github-app` over SSH: the copy shortcut now says how the sign-in URL was copied instead of always claiming success, and the URL appears immediately when no browser can open
Fixed shell commands carried over from the foreground logging an internal error or showing a misleading `[exited with code -1]` line when they finish in background sessions
Fixed a version-less marketplace plugin's live cache directory being deleted and recreated on a second-scope install, which could disrupt a running session using it
Fixed Remote Control sessions started with `/remote-control` not reporting the working-tree diff to connected clients
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions reporting `running` before Claude Code had started, which could trigger a premature "Claude is waiting for your input" notification from the Claude desktop app
Fixed first-run setup exiting with "Unable to connect to Anthropic services" when managed settings configure Claude apps gateway sign-in and Anthropic endpoints are unreachable
Fixed cloud sessions (Claude Code on the web, desktop and mobile apps) sometimes showing the previous permission mode when you switch modes right after sending a message
Fixed cloud sessions going silent when the session's container restarts between turns while a background agent, shell, or monitor is still running — the resumed session now reports the lost work
Improved plugin marketplace hardening: names containing control or invisible characters are rejected, and marketplace-supplied text in `/plugin` and `claude plugin` output is escape-safe
Improved Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry sessions (and any with telemetry disabled): Claude is now told when a configured MCP server failed to connect, instead of concluding its tools don't exist
Changed Sonnet 5's default auto-compact window to its full 1M context, so sessions on the 1M window now auto-compact at about 967K tokens instead of about 934K
Changed cross-session peer messages to collapse by default to a one-line `Message from @<sender>: <first line>` preview; Ctrl+O expands the full body
Changed terminal hyperlinks in rendered markdown: link targets that point at a network or automounter path, contain a control character, or lead with an invisible character now render as plain text
Changed the prompt-footer PR badge to skip its GitHub re-check on terminal refocus when the last check is under a minute old
Changed analytics to stay off from startup, not only after login, when managed settings force gateway login or a custom OAuth deployment is configured
Changed Claude apps gateway sign-in requests to identify Claude Code (a `surface=claude_code` device-authorization parameter and a `claude-code/<version>` User-Agent)
Changed organization sign-in enforcement to exit at start when the administrator's managed settings cannot be read, even if host-supplied or per-user Windows registry settings exist

title.zh-TW: 工作階段出錯自動彙整草稿，快速檢視送出回報
title.en: SendFeedback drafts bug reports on session errors for quick review

body.zh-TW: 在工作階段遇到錯誤或異常時，Claude 現在會透過 `SendFeedback` 工具主動替你整理一份回報草稿。你可以使用 `/feedback` 指令檢視內容、確認無誤後再送出，省去手動複製錯誤訊息與描述問題的繁瑣步驟。若不需要這項輔助，也能在個人設定加入 `{"feedbackDrafts": false}` 隨時關閉草稿功能。⟦這如同實驗紀錄系統在測試失敗時自動彙整觀測結果成報告草稿，等研究人員檢視無誤後才正式提交。⟧
body.en: When something goes wrong in a session, Claude can now use the `SendFeedback` tool to automatically draft a feedback report for you. You can review the details and send it straight from `/feedback`, saving you from manually copying error logs and writing bug reports. If you prefer not to have drafts generated, you can turn them off by setting `{"feedbackDrafts": false}` in your configuration. ⟦It is like a lab record system that gathers observations into a report draft after a failed test, waiting for a researcher to review it before submission.⟧

items.original: Added the `SendFeedback` tool: when something goes wrong in a session, Claude can draft a feedback report for you to review and send from `/feedback` (turn off with the `feedbackDrafts` setting)

title.zh-TW: 載入提示支援自訂輪播，企業可配置專屬公告檔
title.en: Custom spinner tips allow organizations to rotate in-house guidance

body.zh-TW:
企業想在載入等待時向團隊成員展示專屬指引，可在個人設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 加入 `spinnerTipsOverride`。⟦這好比公司大廳的動態看板，除了播放總部預設宣導，還能插入內部通知。⟧可直接貼上：
```json
{"spinnerTipsOverride": {"label": "團隊提示", "tipsFile": "~/.claude/team-tips.json"}}
```
其中 `tipsFile` 指向獨立提示檔，`label` 是顯示名稱；提示項目可包含 `{id, text, cooldownSessions, priority}`，並會與內建提示輪播。
body.en:
Organizations that want to display custom guidance while Claude is thinking can add `spinnerTipsOverride` to `~/.claude/settings.json`. ⟦Like an office lobby display board that shows internal notices alongside the standard announcements.⟧ Paste this complete setting:
```json
{"spinnerTipsOverride": {"label": "Team tips", "tipsFile": "~/.claude/team-tips.json"}}
```
`tipsFile` points to a separate tips file, and `label` is its display name. Tip entries can include `{id, text, cooldownSessions, priority}` and rotate alongside built-in tips.

items.original: Added `{id, text, cooldownSessions, priority}` entries, `tipsFile`, and `label` to `spinnerTipsOverride`, so organizations can rotate their own tips alongside the built-in ones

title.zh-TW: Bash 權限確認增設指引，可直接切換至自動模式
title.en: Bash prompts offer a one-keystroke switch into auto mode

body.zh-TW: 當終端機跳出 Bash 指令執行權限的確認提示時，介面現在會附上引導至自動模式的說明提示。⟦自助洗衣店的螢幕除了讓你確認這次洗程，也會提示可改用自動方案，並提供「同意並切換為自動模式」按鍵；按一下便同時開啟本次洗程與自動選擇。⟧你只要按一下按鍵，就能選擇「Yes, and switch to auto mode」，在允許當前指令執行的同時直接切換至自動模式，省去後續反覆手動確認的繁瑣操作。
body.en: When a Bash permission prompt appears in your terminal, it now includes a helpful tip pointing toward auto mode. ⟦A self-service laundry screen can confirm this wash while suggesting an automatic program, with one button that both starts the current wash and enables automatic selection.⟧ A single keystroke allows you to select "Yes, and switch to auto mode", granting permission for the current command while immediately engaging auto mode so you don't have to keep approving routine operations.

items.original: Added a tip on Bash permission prompts pointing to auto mode, with a one-keystroke "Yes, and switch to auto mode" option

title.zh-TW: 新增成本調校指令，五大槓桿逐項分析 API 支出
title.en: /claude-api cost-optimize profiles spending and works through cost levers

body.zh-TW: 想替專案節省 API 開銷的使用者，現在可以使用 `/claude-api cost-optimize` 指令分析現有專案的支出結構。該功能會依序帶你檢視快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）、批次處理、運算深度以及模型選擇等成本槓桿。系統也會協助評估 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）的精簡策略，並以單次一個具體量測改動的方式逐步調校。⟦這就像請一位專業精算師逐筆審查帳單，按部就班調整各項用量槓桿，每次微調都量測實際節省成效。⟧
body.en: To rein in API expenses on an existing codebase, you can now run `/claude-api cost-optimize` to profile your project's Claude API spend. It guides you systematically through key cost levers including caching, batch processing, effort levels, and model choices. It also assists in token hygiene, testing one measured change at a time. ⟦It is like having a financial auditor inspect your operational bills line by line, methodically tweaking cost dials and measuring the precise savings after each adjustment.⟧

items.original: Added `/claude-api cost-optimize` to profile an existing project's Claude API spend and work through cost levers (caching, token hygiene, batch, effort, model choice) one measured change at a time

title.zh-TW: API 技能涵蓋管理端點，支援成員、金鑰與加密配置
title.en: /claude-api skill expands coverage across the Admin API suite

body.zh-TW: 管理企業級 API 資源的使用者，現在能透過更新後的 `/claude-api` 技能直接操作 Admin API 的各項管理功能。⟦這如同活動統籌坐在同一張後台總表前，能集中處理參加名單、邀請、場地、器材編號與用量報表，也能安排合作團隊的身分串接和自管保險箱密碼。⟧該支援涵蓋組織成員名冊、邀請函發送、工作空間劃分、API 金鑰管理與速率限制用量報告。此外也納入了工作負載身分識別同盟（WIF）的配置。針對安全加密，系統也一併支援客戶託管加密金鑰（CMEK）等進階選項。
body.en: Managing enterprise API resources is now much simpler with the updated `/claude-api` skill, which extends coverage across the Admin API suite. ⟦Like an event producer using one backstage control sheet to coordinate attendee lists, invitations, venues, equipment labels, and usage reports, while also arranging partner identity links and a self-managed vault code.⟧ It supports organization members, invites, workspaces, API keys, and rate limit reports. Workload identity federation (WIF) is fully included. Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) are also supported for enterprise security.

items.original: Updated the `/claude-api` skill with Admin API coverage (organization members, invites, workspaces, API keys, rate limit reports, workload identity federation, CMEK)

title.zh-TW: 修復選單快速連按時序，不再誤觸游標上一行選項
title.en: Rapid arrow and Enter sequences accurately trigger the selected menu item

body.zh-TW: 在選單中快速切換選項時，系統不再因為按鍵反應落後而選錯上一行。過去在歷史搜尋、`/config`、`/mcp`、`/skills`、背景任務列表以及 `/model` 介面中，如果以極快速度連按方向鍵與 Enter 鍵，游標會誤觸剛才游標上方的那一列；現在按鍵時序已修正，確保選定的就是眼前停留的項目。⟦這像電梯按鈕消除了判定延遲，快速連按時會準確停在你最終按下的樓層，不再因按太快而誤停在上一層。⟧
body.en: Rapidly navigating interactive menus no longer triggers the wrong item due to timing latency. Previously, typing a rapid sequence of arrow keys and Enter in history search, `/config`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, background tasks, or `/model` could accidentally act on the row directly above your target; input event processing is now fixed to reliably target your current selection. ⟦Like an elevator panel that eliminates button lag, stopping precisely at the floor you selected even when you tap the controls in rapid succession.⟧

items.original: Fixed fast arrow-key + Enter sequences acting on the row above the one you navigated to in history search, `/config`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, background tasks, and `/model`

title.zh-TW: 子代理遭遇模型 404 自動切換備援，回傳詳細錯誤代碼
title.en: Sub-agents handle 404s via fallback chains and detailed diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 當子代理在首次呼叫模型時遭遇 404 找不到模型的錯誤，系統不再讓它直接死當。⟦這好比客服總機發現主要分機無法接通時，會依序轉接備援分機；若全都失敗，仍會留下故障類型、狀態碼、案件 ID 與分機名稱。⟧現在子代理會依序使用當前工作階段設定的備援模型鏈繼續嘗試，而且回傳給父代理的錯誤訊息中，會完整包含錯誤類型、狀態碼、請求 ID（request id）以及目標模型名稱，方便排查問題。
body.en: Sub-agents no longer crash outright when their initial API call encounters a 404 model not found error. ⟦Like a switchboard that tries backup extensions when the main line cannot connect, then records the failure type, status, case ID, and extension name if every line fails.⟧ Instead, they now transition smoothly through the session's fallback model chain, and if the operation still fails, the error sent back to the parent agent includes the error type, status, request id, and model name.

items.original: Fixed sub-agents dying on a first-call model 404: they now use the session's fallback model chain, and the error returned to the parent includes the error type, status, request id, and model

title.zh-TW: 海量錯誤輸出不再塞爆對話，防止工作階段卡死
title.en: Large error outputs no longer wedge sessions with prompt length errors

body.zh-TW: 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）或背景代理若噴出數 MB 的海量錯誤訊息，過去會直接塞爆對話紀錄，導致工作階段卡死在「Prompt is too long」而無法繼續輸入。現在系統已修正溢位處理機制，防止過量的錯誤輸出癱瘓對話。⟦宛如水壩設有溢洪道，暴雨帶來大量水流時先導走多餘水量，不讓整座水庫堵塞而影響正常供水。⟧
body.en: Hooks or background agents that dump megabytes of error output can no longer flood the conversation history and wedge the session on "Prompt is too long". The system now prevents excessive diagnostic output from overwhelming the context window, keeping your terminal responsive. ⟦Like a dam's spillway routing away excess water during a storm so the reservoir does not clog and interrupt its normal supply.⟧

items.original: Fixed a hook or background agent that printed megabytes of error output being able to overflow the conversation and wedge the session on "Prompt is too long"

title.zh-TW: kitty 終端協定支援非拉丁鍵盤，Ctrl 快捷鍵正常觸發
title.en: Ctrl shortcuts trigger reliably under non-Latin layouts in kitty terminals

body.zh-TW: 在支援 kitty 協定的終端機中，使用非拉丁鍵盤配置（例如西里爾字母）的使用者，現在按下 Ctrl 快捷鍵組合也能正常觸發功能。過去在切換為非拉丁輸入法時，Ctrl 按鍵訊號無法被正確辨識；修復後無論目前的輸入語言為何，組合鍵都能精確送達。⟦好比多語鍵盤的翻譯晶片修復了解碼邏輯，不論切換到哪種字母排列，只要按住控制鍵，系統都能認出底層標準的快捷指令。⟧
body.en: Using Ctrl keyboard shortcuts in terminals supporting the kitty keyboard protocol now works reliably under non-Latin keyboard layouts such as Cyrillic. Previously, switching input layouts prevented modifier key combinations from firing; keyboard event translation is now fixed across all keyboard configurations. ⟦Like a multi-language keyboard controller that accurately resolves core shortcut signals regardless of which alphabet layout is currently active.⟧

items.original: Fixed Ctrl keyboard shortcuts not firing under non-Latin (e.g. Cyrillic) keyboard layouts in kitty-protocol terminals

title.zh-TW: 滑鼠分段回報不再插入亂碼，過濾殘留跳脫字元
title.en: Split mouse reporting packets no longer leak raw text into prompts

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠回報資料若在跳脫字元前綴剛送出時被切成兩段讀取，過去會導致像 `<35;150;7M` 這樣的殘留字串被當成文字硬生生塞進提示輸入框裡。⟦這如同電報機修好了斷句機制，就算控制訊號在中途稍微停頓，也不會把座標數據誤當成正文印在紙上。⟧現在系統修正了終端機輸入串流的解析邏輯，即便滑鼠封包被拆成多次讀取，也能完整辨識並過濾掉控制碼。
body.en: Mouse tracking reports that arrive split across stream reads directly after an escape prefix will no longer dump stray text fragments like `<35;150;7M` straight into your prompt input. ⟦Like a telegraph printer that recognizes split control signals, preventing raw coordinate numbers from leaking onto the printed letter as plain text.⟧ Input stream buffering now properly reconstructs split control sequences.

items.original: Fixed text like `<35;150;7M` being inserted into the prompt when a mouse report arrived split across reads right after the escape prefix

title.zh-TW: 沙盒清理保留外部捷徑，防止設定檔符號連結遭誤刪
title.en: Bash sandbox cleanup preserves dotfile-managed settings symlinks

body.zh-TW: 使用 nix/home-manager 或 GNU stow 等工具管理設定檔的使用者，不再需要擔心個人設定檔被意外刪除。過去當 Bash 沙盒在指令執行完畢進行清理時，若指向外部的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）`~/.claude/settings.json` 被重導至沙盒可寫入區域之外，清理程序會將該連結檔案直接刪除；現在沙盒已修正保護邏輯。⟦此舉如同打掃人員清理置物箱時，認得貼在外面的捷徑標籤，不會把屋主辛苦用工具管理的設定檔連根拔除。⟧
body.en: Users managing dotfiles with tools like nix/home-manager or GNU stow no longer risk having their configuration link erased. Previously, when the Bash sandbox cleaned up after running a command, if the `~/.claude/settings.json` symlink was repointed outside the sandbox's writable area, the cleanup routine deleted the symlink; the sandbox now safely preserves these links. ⟦Like a cleanup crew that recognizes an external reference label on a storage box, keeping your carefully organized configuration shortcuts intact.⟧

items.original: Fixed the Bash sandbox's after-command cleanup deleting a dotfile-managed `~/.claude/settings.json` symlink (nix/home-manager, stow) when it is repointed outside the sandbox's writable area

title.zh-TW: Zed 鍵盤設定改為合併寫入，完整保留既有按鍵綁定
title.en: /terminal-setup merges keybindings into Zed keymaps without overwriting

body.zh-TW: 在 Zed 編輯器設定終端機快捷鍵時，執行 `/terminal-setup` 指令不再粗暴地洗掉你既有的全部按鍵綁定。⟦這如同圖書館登記借閱時，管理員只在你的卡片空白處加蓋新章，而不是把寫滿個人備忘的整張借書證撕掉換新。⟧過去該指令會直接覆寫整個 `keymap.json` 檔案；現在它懂得將所需的快捷鍵合併進現有設定中，完整保留你原先自訂的其他按鍵組合。
body.en: Running `/terminal-setup` to configure keybindings for the Zed editor no longer wipes out your entire keymap configuration. ⟦Like adding a new entry to an address book by jotting it on an empty line, rather than replacing the whole notebook with a blank one.⟧ Instead of completely overwriting `keymap.json`, the command now cleanly merges its required keybindings into your existing file, preserving all your personal custom shortcuts.

items.original: Fixed `/terminal-setup` overwriting your entire Zed `keymap.json` instead of merging in its keybinding

title.zh-TW: 改名失敗明確提示同步狀態，不再靜默確認
title.en: /rename warns when registry updates fail instead of silently confirming

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/rename` 指令重新命名當前對話時，若內部工作階段註冊表（session registry）因故無法同步更新，系統不再假裝一切成功並默默確認。現在它會明確顯示提示訊息，告知其他工作階段可能暫時仍會顯示舊名稱，讓資訊維持透明。⟦這宛如戶政事務所改名時，若分局系統連線延遲，辦事員會主動提醒你其他窗口可能暫時還掛著舊名字，避免產生誤會。⟧
body.en: When running `/rename` to rename your session, the interface no longer gives a silent confirmation if the session registry cannot be updated. It now explicitly alerts you that other sessions might still display the old name, ensuring you are aware of the registry state. ⟦Like a registration desk informing you that while your name tag is updated locally, other department screens might still reflect your previous name until sync completes.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/rename` silently confirming when the session registry could not be updated; it now says other sessions may still show the old name

title.zh-TW: 代理對話摘要依循專屬提示詞，不再套用預設模板
title.en: Agent summaries retain custom system prompts during context compaction

body.zh-TW: 以 `--agent` 參數啟動自訂代理工作階段時，執行 `/compact` 壓縮指令或點選「Summarize from here」整理脈絡時，系統過去會錯誤套用預設的系統提示詞來產生摘要。現在摘要程序已修正為嚴格依循該對話專屬的自訂系統提示詞，確保代理的角色定位與特殊規則在濃縮後依然完整維持。⟦像隨身秘書整理會議精華時，全程依照該專案的特約指引記錄，不會突然套用總公司的制式格式。⟧
body.en: Sessions launched with `--agent` now maintain their custom system prompt during context compaction. Previously, running `/compact` or using "Summarize from here" caused the summary to be generated under the generic default system prompt; it now strictly preserves the conversation's own prompt instructions. ⟦Like an assistant summarizing a project workshop according to the project's unique guidelines, rather than reverting to a generic corporate template.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/compact` and "Summarize from here" in sessions started with `--agent` summarizing under the default system prompt instead of the conversation's own

title.zh-TW: 背景代理終端終止即時報錯，按 Enter 鍵可重新啟動
title.en: Dead background agent sessions fail promptly with a restart key

body.zh-TW: 在 `claude agents` 列表中檢視背景工作階段時，若終端機宿主處理程序意外終止，該列過去會永遠卡在「opening…」狀態。⟦這好比航班動態看板，當班機因故取消時，看板會在幾秒內亮出原因並提供重定班機選項，不再永遠卡在登機中。⟧現在系統會在數秒內將該列標記為失敗並清楚顯示具體原因，你只需按下 Enter 鍵就能直接重新啟動該工作階段。
body.en: In the `claude agents` list, background sessions whose terminal host process died will no longer remain stuck displaying "opening…" forever. ⟦Like an airport status board that clearly marks a cancelled flight with the underlying reason within seconds and provides a rebooking prompt, instead of staying frozen on boarding status.⟧ The row now marks itself as failed within seconds along with the failure reason, and pressing Enter immediately restarts the session.

items.original: Fixed a background session showing "opening…" forever in `claude agents` after its terminal host process died; the row now fails within seconds with the reason, and Enter restarts it

title.zh-TW: 輸出檔無法寫入時限制記憶體，檔案加註遺失段落
title.en: Output write failures cap memory growth and mark where output was lost

body.zh-TW: 當掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）或背景任務的輸出檔案因權限等原因無法寫入磁碟時，系統過去會在記憶體中無限累積暫存資料導致記憶體暴增。現在記憶體限制已獲得控制，且日後輸出檔案恢復可寫時，檔案內會明確加註哪一段輸出內容已遺失。⟦正如印表機卡紙時不再把列印佇列無限堆在快取記憶體直到當機，而是適時捨棄並在補紙後的第一頁清楚印上斷印標記。⟧
body.en: If a hook or background task cannot write to its output file, the system no longer buffers the data indefinitely in memory, preventing unbounded memory growth. Additionally, the log file now records an explicit note indicating where output was lost. ⟦Like a printer running out of paper that stops filling memory buffers to avoid crashes, later marking the exact point where pages were dropped once writing resumes.⟧

items.original: Fixed unbounded memory growth when a hook's or background task's output file could not be written; the file now notes where output was lost

title.zh-TW: SSH 安裝 GitHub 應用程式改善，複製狀態與網址顯示更明確
title.en: GitHub App setup over SSH clarifies copy channels and displays URLs

body.zh-TW: 在遠端 SSH 連線環境下執行 `/install-github-app` 指令時，登入體驗變得更加可靠。複製快捷鍵現在會如實說明登入網址是如何複製的，不再盲目宣稱複製成功；當遠端伺服器無法自動開啟本機瀏覽器時，登入網址也會第一時間直接印在畫面上供你手動點擊。⟦這好比遠端電話辦公時，系統不再含糊回報文件已送到桌面，而是明確告知傳遞管道並立即把登入網址顯示在畫面上。⟧
body.en: Running `/install-github-app` over an SSH connection now handles clipboard and browser limitations gracefully. The copy shortcut explicitly reports how the sign-in URL was copied rather than falsely claiming universal success, and if no browser can be opened remotely, the URL prints immediately to the screen. ⟦Like a remote dispatcher who clearly explains which channel sent your authorization link, displaying the URL on screen immediately when a direct browser launch isn't possible.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/install-github-app` over SSH: the copy shortcut now says how the sign-in URL was copied instead of always claiming success, and the URL appears immediately when no browser can open

title.zh-TW: 前景指令移轉背景執行收尾，不再誤報 code -1 錯誤
title.en: Commands carried into the background report cleanly upon completion

body.zh-TW: 由前景轉移至背景工作階段執行的 Shell 指令，在執行完畢時不再跳出內部錯誤紀錄或誤導人的 `[exited with code -1]` 退出碼。⟦這像接力賽把跑者移交給後援隊伍後，跑者抵達終點能順利繳回號碼牌，不會被計分板誤記為違規棄權或拋出錯誤碼。⟧現在指令在背景順利收尾時能正確回報真實狀態，避免造成執行失敗的假象。
body.en: Shell commands handed off from the foreground to background sessions no longer log internal errors or display a misleading `[exited with code -1]` banner upon completion. ⟦Like passing a baton to a relay teammate who finishes the lap smoothly, without the scoreboard mistakenly displaying a disqualification code at the finish line.⟧ Background task status is now reported cleanly upon normal termination.

items.original: Fixed shell commands carried over from the foreground logging an internal error or showing a misleading `[exited with code -1]` line when they finish in background sessions

title.zh-TW: 多範圍安裝外掛保護快取，避免中斷運作中工作階段
title.en: Multi-scope plugin installations protect active cache directories

body.zh-TW: 當你在不同範圍重複安裝同一個未標註版號的市集外掛時，系統過去會直接刪除並重建既有的快取目錄。這往往會干擾到正在使用該外掛的工作階段；現在快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）處理邏輯已獲得修正，第二個範圍的安裝動作不會再中斷運作中的程式。⟦這就如同在同一棟大樓為第二間辦公室裝設相同設備時，工人不會拔掉走廊正在運轉的共用電源，確保第一間辦公室照常運作。⟧
body.en: Installing a version-less marketplace plugin across a second scope no longer purges and recreates its active cache directory. This eliminates the risk of disrupting existing, active sessions that are currently executing the plugin. ⟦Like setting up shared office equipment in a second room without unplugging the active server in the hallway that the first room is still using.⟧

items.original: Fixed a version-less marketplace plugin's live cache directory being deleted and recreated on a second-scope install, which could disrupt a running session using it

title.zh-TW: 遠端遙控同步工作樹差異，連線端即時掌握修改進度
title.en: Remote Control sessions broadcast live working-tree diffs to clients

body.zh-TW: 透過 `/remote-control` 指令開啟遠端控制工作階段時，已連線的用戶端現在能正確收到目前工作樹的修改差異（working-tree diff）。⟦像遠端視訊會議中主講人順利同步投影畫面，遠端與會者能即時看見最新修改的文件對照，掌握工作進度。⟧過去這些變更資訊未被同步傳遞給連線端；修正後遠端操作者能即時檢視檔案的具體改動，大幅提升遠端協作的透明度。
body.en: Remote Control sessions launched via `/remote-control` now reliably broadcast the working-tree diff to connected clients. ⟦Like a screen-sharing presenter who accurately projects the live edit diffs, ensuring all remote attendees see precisely what is being modified.⟧ Previously, attached clients could not see pending file modifications; this sync issue is resolved so remote collaborators see current changes in real time.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control sessions started with `/remote-control` not reporting the working-tree diff to connected clients

title.zh-TW: 自託管執行器延後回報運作狀態，防止提早發出等待通知
title.en: Self-hosted runners delay running state until startup completes

body.zh-TW: 自託管執行器（self-hosted runner）的工作階段過去在 Claude Code 尚未正式啟動前，就會提早回報為「running」運作中狀態，導致 Claude 桌面應用程式過早發出「Claude is waiting for your input」的提示通知。現在狀態回報時機已修正，只有在主程式真正啟動並就緒後才會發送通知。⟦如同劇場在布景與燈光尚未就緒時不亮起開演燈，避免前台過早通知觀眾可以入場。⟧
body.en: Self-hosted runner sessions no longer report a "running" status before Claude Code has actually booted up. This eliminates premature "Claude is waiting for your input" notifications fired by the Claude desktop app while initialization is still underway. ⟦Like a theater that keeps its opening light off until its set and lighting are ready, avoiding an early signal that the audience may enter.⟧

items.original: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions reporting `running` before Claude Code had started, which could trigger a premature "Claude is waiting for your input" notification from the Claude desktop app

title.zh-TW: 受管閘道登入修復端點檢查，離線環境順利完成初次設定
title.en: Gateway setups complete first-run initialization without public endpoints

body.zh-TW: 在由管理員統一派發的受管設定（managed settings）中，若指定透過 Claude 應用程式閘道登入，而環境對外無法連線至 Anthropic 預設端點，初次啟動設定過去會直接報錯並退出。⟦就像博物館正門關閉時，導覽人員仍能循指定服務通道帶新訪客到報到桌，不會取消入場手續。⟧現在系統已修正連線判斷邏輯，優先依循閘道設定順利完成初次設定，保障封閉網路環境的可用性。
body.en: First-run setup no longer abruptly aborts with "Unable to connect to Anthropic services" when managed settings configure gateway sign-in for Claude apps while standard Anthropic endpoints are blocked. ⟦When a museum's main entrance is closed, a guide can still use the designated service corridor to bring a new visitor to the check-in desk rather than cancelling admission.⟧ Initial configuration proceeds smoothly over the designated gateway channel.

items.original: Fixed first-run setup exiting with "Unable to connect to Anthropic services" when managed settings configure Claude apps gateway sign-in and Anthropic endpoints are unreachable

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段修復權限切換時序，送出訊息不再閃退舊模式
title.en: Cloud sessions preserve newly toggled permission modes after sending messages

body.zh-TW: 在網頁版、桌面版或行動應用程式中使用雲端工作階段時，若在剛送出訊息的瞬間立即切換權限模式，介面過去有時會因為非同步傳輸的順序衝突，而跳回先前顯示的舊模式。現在狀態同步順序已獲得修復，無論你送出訊息後多快切換權限，模式切換都能精確反映當下的最新選擇，不再遺失設定。⟦這如同影像編輯器在按下儲存的同時切換工具，工具列仍保留剛選好的工具，不會跳回上一個。⟧
body.en: In cloud sessions across web, desktop, and mobile apps, rapidly toggling your permission mode right after dispatching a message no longer causes the UI to flicker back to the prior mode. State synchronization now ensures your updated mode remains active regardless of network transmission timing. ⟦Like an image editor that preserves the tool you just selected when you switch tools at the same moment you save, instead of reverting to the previous one.⟧

items.original: Fixed cloud sessions (Claude Code on the web, desktop and mobile apps) sometimes showing the previous permission mode when you switch modes right after sending a message

title.zh-TW: 雲端容器重啟主動回報進度，清楚列出受影響背景任務
title.en: Resumed cloud sessions report lost background tasks after container restarts

body.zh-TW: 當雲端工作階段在回合之間發生容器重啟，而背後的代理程式、Shell 指令或監控程序仍在執行時，系統過去在重啟後會陷入無聲無息的沉默狀態，讓你誤以為任務仍在背景順暢運作。現在工作階段在恢復連線後，會主動向你回報受影響的中斷工作項目與遺失進度，確保執行狀況一目了然。⟦宛如雲端主機中途重開後，復工的助理會主動遞上中斷清單，清楚交代哪些背景作業受到影響，不再假裝沒事發生。⟧
body.en: If a cloud session's container restarts between turns while background agents, shells, or monitors are active, the resumed session no longer silently drops into limbo. It now explicitly reports any lost work and background processes that were interrupted. ⟦Like an office assistant who hands you an incident briefing after an unexpected power reset, clearly detailing which background tasks were interrupted instead of acting like nothing happened.⟧

items.original: Fixed cloud sessions going silent when the session's container restarts between turns while a background agent, shell, or monitor is still running — the resumed session now reports the lost work

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集強化字元防護，拒絕隱形字元並安全跳脫輸出
title.en: Plugin marketplace hardens safety against invisible names and output escapes

body.zh-TW: 外掛市集的安全防護機制獲得全面強化。⟦這好比市集招牌經過嚴格安檢，禁止懸掛夾帶隱形墨水或控制指令的看板，確保公告文字安全無害。⟧系統現在會主動拒絕包含控制字元或隱形字元的外掛名稱，防止惡意命名欺騙；同時，在 `/plugin` 與 `claude plugin` 的輸出結果中，來自市集的說明文字也全面經過跳脫安全處理，避免終端機被惡意格式字串攻擊。
body.en: Plugin marketplace security has been hardened against terminal tampering. ⟦Like an official market inspection that bans vendor signs with invisible ink or hidden tripwires, ensuring public boards display text safely.⟧ Plugin names containing control or invisible characters are now strictly rejected, and all text supplied by marketplaces rendered in `/plugin` and `claude plugin` is escape-safe.

items.original: Improved plugin marketplace hardening: names containing control or invisible characters are rejected, and marketplace-supplied text in `/plugin` and `claude plugin` output is escape-safe

title.zh-TW: 外部工具連線失敗明確通報，防止誤判工具不存在
title.en: Bedrock and Vertex sessions explicitly report MCP server connection failures

body.zh-TW: 在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 平台或停用遙測的工作階段中，當設定的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器連線失敗時，系統現在會明確告知 Claude 連線失敗的事實，避免 Claude 誤以為該工具根本不存在。⟦這相當於通訊官向指揮官明確回報線路故障，讓指揮官清楚設備只是暫時連不上，而不是誤認倉庫裡從未配發該項工具。⟧
body.en: In Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or telemetry-disabled sessions, Claude is now explicitly informed when a configured MCP (Model Context Protocol) server fails to connect, instead of hallucinating that the tools do not exist. ⟦Like a radio operator clearly reporting that a remote supply depot line is down, so the commander knows tools exist but are temporarily unreachable, rather than assuming they were never assigned.⟧

items.original: Improved Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry sessions (and any with telemetry disabled): Claude is now told when a configured MCP server failed to connect, instead of concluding its tools don't exist

title.zh-TW: Sonnet 5 放寬自動壓縮門檻，百萬上下文支援至 967K
title.en: Sonnet 5 expands auto-compact thresholds to 967K on 1M context windows

body.zh-TW: 使用 Sonnet 5 模型並開啟 1M 上下文視窗的使用者，系統現在將預設自動壓縮門檻調整為完整的 1M 容量。工作階段觸發自動壓縮的時機由原本約 934K token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）延後至約 967K token，讓長對話能容納更多未壓縮的歷史紀錄。⟦好比把記事本的翻頁警戒線往後推移，充分利用完整的百萬空間，寫到約 967K 單位時才啟動濃縮。⟧
body.en: Sonnet 5's default auto-compact threshold now scales to its full 1M context window. Sessions on the 1M window will automatically compact context at approximately 967K tokens instead of roughly 934K tokens, unlocking more working room for long interactions. ⟦Like moving the review bookmark further back in a massive notebook, allowing you to fill up to about 967K units of notes before initiating a summary pass.⟧

items.original: Changed Sonnet 5's default auto-compact window to its full 1M context, so sessions on the 1M window now auto-compact at about 967K tokens instead of about 934K

title.zh-TW: 跨工作階段訊息預設單行摺疊，按 Ctrl+O 可展開全文
title.en: Cross-session peer messages collapse to single lines with Ctrl+O expansion

body.zh-TW: 在多個工作階段之間傳遞的對等訊息，現在預設會摺疊為單行預覽格式 `Message from @<sender>: <first line>`。當你需要檢視完整內容時，只需按下 Ctrl+O 即可立即展開全部內文，保持主對話畫面的整潔清爽。⟦這彷彿活頁講義先只露出章節標題與第一行，桌面保持整齊；需要細讀時再用快捷鍵攤開整頁。⟧
body.en: Peer messages sent across sessions are now collapsed by default into a single-line preview showing `Message from @<sender>: <first line>`. You can press Ctrl+O at any time to expand and read the full body without cluttering your main stream. ⟦Like loose-leaf study notes that show only a chapter heading and first line until you use a shortcut to open the full page.⟧

items.original: Changed cross-session peer messages to collapse by default to a one-line `Message from @<sender>: <first line>` preview; Ctrl+O expands the full body

title.zh-TW: 終端機過濾特殊路徑超連結，可疑目標自動降級純文字
title.en: Markdown hyperlinks pointing to network paths render as plain text

body.zh-TW: 終端機在渲染 Markdown 格式的超連結時加入了更嚴格的安全防護限制。若連結目標指向遠端網路路徑、自動掛載路徑、含有特殊控制字元或以隱形字元開頭，系統會將其自動降級為不可點擊的純文字顯示，防止終端機誤觸潛在的惡意路徑或觸發非預期的網路連線行為。⟦正如門禁把來源可疑或夾帶隱藏符號的感應卡降為普通紙卡，不能刷開門，避免有人誤用。⟧
body.en: Terminal hyperlinks rendered from Markdown now enforce safer formatting rules. Link targets that point to network or automounter paths, contain control characters, or lead with invisible characters are automatically rendered as plain text rather than clickable links. ⟦Like access control that downgrades a suspicious keycard or one with hidden symbols to an ordinary paper card that cannot open a door.⟧

items.original: Changed terminal hyperlinks in rendered markdown: link targets that point at a network or automounter path, contain a control character, or lead with an invisible character now render as plain text

title.zh-TW: PR 狀態標籤增設一分鐘快取，視窗重焦略過重複查詢
title.en: Prompt PR badge skips refocus checks when data is under a minute old

body.zh-TW: 終端機底部的 Pull Request 標籤現在具備了更聰明的快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）機制。當你切換視窗重新回到終端機時，如果距離上一次檢查的時間不到一分鐘，系統會略過向 GitHub 重新查詢的動作，減少多餘的網路請求並避免介面卡頓。⟦好比手錶在切換視窗時不會每秒向衛星校時，只要上一分鐘內才核對過，就直接顯示既有資訊以節省資源。⟧
body.en: The pull request badge in the prompt footer now optimizes its GitHub network calls. When refocusing your terminal window, it skips the GitHub re-check if the previous check occurred under a minute ago, saving bandwidth and keeping your prompt snappy. ⟦Like a watch that doesn't ping satellites every second you glance at it, relying on a check performed less than a minute ago to conserve battery.⟧

items.original: Changed the prompt-footer PR badge to skip its GitHub re-check on terminal refocus when the last check is under a minute old

title.zh-TW: 自訂認證啟動即關閉遙測，全程落實企業隱私規範
title.en: Analytics remain completely off from startup for gateway and OAuth setups

body.zh-TW: 在受管設定強制使用閘道登入或配置自訂 OAuth 的企業環境下，遙測分析資料收集功能現在從程式啟動時起便會一直保持關閉狀態。系統不再等到使用者完成登入驗證後才停用收集，從最初初始化階段就徹底保障企業內部環境的隱私與合規要求，因此不會在登入前留下分析資料。⟦這如同重視隱私的會議室在開門時就關閉錄音設備，不必等訪客完成簽到才停錄。⟧
body.en: Telemetry and analytics now remain disabled starting from process startup, rather than waiting until after login, whenever managed settings enforce gateway login or a custom OAuth deployment is active. ⟦Like a privacy-conscious meeting room that switches its recording equipment off as the door opens, rather than waiting for a visitor to finish checking in.⟧

items.original: Changed analytics to stay off from startup, not only after login, when managed settings force gateway login or a custom OAuth deployment is configured

title.zh-TW: 閘道登入攜帶身分參數，明確標記客戶端來源與版號
title.en: Claude apps gateway sign-ins explicitly identify Claude Code clients

body.zh-TW: 透過應用程式閘道進行登入請求時，系統現在會在驗證流程中明確標註客戶端身分。⟦這像舞台器材貼上所屬劇團與版號標籤，控制台一看便知道來源並套用對應規則。⟧具體包含在裝置授權參數中帶上 `surface=claude_code`，並在 HTTP 標頭的 User-Agent 註明 `claude-code/<version>` 版號，方便後端閘道精確識別並套用存取政策。
body.en: Gateway sign-in requests for Claude apps now explicitly identify Claude Code to the authorization server. ⟦Like stage equipment labelled with its theater company and version, so the control desk can identify its source and apply the matching rules.⟧ Requests include a `surface=claude_code` parameter during device authorization and specify a `claude-code/<version>` User-Agent header.

items.original: Changed Claude apps gateway sign-in requests to identify Claude Code (a `surface=claude_code` device-authorization parameter and a `claude-code/<version>` User-Agent)

title.zh-TW: 受管設定無法讀取即刻終止，防止安全管制遭繞過
title.en: Organization enforcement exits on unreadable managed settings

body.zh-TW: 在啟用組織登入強制管制的環境下，若系統在啟動時無法讀取管理員設定的受管設定（managed settings），程式現在會直接退出並中止執行，即便本機或使用者層級的 Windows 登錄檔中存在相關設定也不會放行，嚴格防範安全防護被繞過。⟦中央食譜讀不到時，廚房便不開火；即使爐旁放著場地或個人的筆記，也不拿來替代正式做法。⟧
body.en: Enforcement of organization sign-in policies now immediately exits at startup if the administrator's managed settings cannot be read. Even if host-supplied or per-user Windows registry settings exist, the tool will refuse to launch without verified administrative policies, closing potential security bypasses. ⟦If the central recipe cannot be read, the kitchen does not start cooking; notes left by the venue or an individual beside the stove cannot replace the official instructions.⟧

items.original: Changed organization sign-in enforcement to exit at start when the administrator's managed settings cannot be read, even if host-supplied or per-user Windows registry settings exist

entries: Added a startup warning for Bash allow rules with a wildcard before the subcommand (e.g. `Bash(git * main)`), since they also match options inserted before the subcommand
Added an Auto mode tab to `/permissions` for viewing and editing auto mode classifier rules
Added the turn's completion time to the end-of-turn duration line, e.g. `✻ Sautéed for 23s · done 6:05 PM`
Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank transcript after resizing the terminal and jumping to the bottom until the next keypress
Fixed a severe transcript slowdown when a diff contained a very long single line (e.g. a base64 string); such lines now render truncated with a marker
Fixed erratic fullscreen scrolling when positioned at an earlier message, including jump-to-bottom getting stuck mid-transcript
Fixed background sessions failing to open after 45 seconds when Claude Code's starting directory had been deleted, the machine had slept, or the host is slow to start processes
Fixed background sessions failing to open with "Couldn't start the background service … EACCES" when another Claude Code process was re-installing the npm package at that moment
Fixed markdown rendering being disabled for a whole message when its first 500 characters contained no markdown, and for `+`/`N)` lists and setext headings
Fixed MCP tool calls interrupted by an incoming message in headless/remote sessions being reported to the model as "completed with no output" instead of an explicit interrupted error
Fixed MCP tool arguments being sent as JSON strings when the parameter's schema is empty (`{}`), instead of their real type
Fixed a command interrupted mid-run showing as "Ran 1 shell command" with no sign it was cut
Fixed pressing ← or running `/background` during a dynamic workflow restarting its finished subagents; it now asks first and says how many subagents would restart
Fixed opening a just-started session in `claude agents` while its worker was still booting (common on Windows) stopping it with "was stopped while the respawn was in flight"
Fixed `claude agents` listing a backgrounded named session twice; backgrounding the same conversation again now numbers the new row (e.g. `my-session (2)`)
Fixed the background retention sweep removing git worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` that you created yourself when an old background-session record pointed at them
Fixed auto mode tool calls being denied as "temporarily unavailable" on very large sessions by scaling the safety-check deadline with prompt size
Fixed the plugin cache creating duplicate SHA-named directories for the same plugin
Fixed plugin skills whose frontmatter `name` already includes the `<plugin>:` prefix showing it doubled in the slash menu (e.g. `/plugin:plugin:skill`)
Fixed `claude plugin update` failing for an installed plugin given its bare name (only the fully-qualified name worked)
Fixed plugin installation failing when `plugin.json` was saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark (BOM)
Fixed `/reload-plugins` reporting 0 skills for plugins that define skills under `skills/*/SKILL.md`
Fixed hook error messages showing a literal `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` instead of the resolved plugin path
Fixed `/rename` replacing the theme's prompt border color (including a custom theme's `promptBorder`) with the default cyan; the border now keeps your theme's color unless you pick one with `/color`
Fixed custom theme diff colors (`diffAdded`/`diffRemoved` and their dimmed variants) being ignored in diffs and the `/theme` preview
Fixed a `keybindings.json` binding with an unknown action name silently deadening that key; it is now skipped so the default binding keeps working, and a warning is logged under `--debug`
Fixed `/stats` activity heatmap showing each day's activity one cell off (Sunday's count under Monday) in timezones east of UTC
Fixed `/fork` from an already-forked or backgrounded session starting the new session with an empty conversation
Fixed prompts beginning with `/--` (e.g. Lean doc comments) being rejected as an unknown slash command instead of being sent to Claude
Fixed the `@` file picker staying open after the typed text stopped matching a real path
Fixed the status line's cost and duration resetting to zero after navigating to the agents view and back
Fixed fullscreen mode moving keyboard focus onto the control under the pointer when you clicked the terminal window only to bring it back into focus
Fixed path completion failing when the completion token or working directory contained a null byte
Windows/macOS: Fixed headless sessions not cleaning up stale entries in `~/.claude/sessions` left by sessions that exited uncleanly
Fixed the UI stopping with a render error on the first tool call when a third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoint (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) streams a `tool_use` block without an `id`
Fixed the Write tool reporting "Out of memory" or freezing for a long time after overwriting a very large existing file, even though the file had been written
Fixed `claude plugin install <name>` exiting silently (or hanging in a terminal) instead of reporting an error when `~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json` is empty or corrupted
Fixed resumed sessions failing every turn with a 400 when the saved history contains tool blocks the Anthropic API does not accept (typically written by a third-party API proxy)
Fixed `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash` failing with "Raw mode is not supported" for some Team/Enterprise users with server-managed settings
Fixed sessions that ended in plan mode resuming outside plan mode in the VS Code extension, and in `claude -p --continue`/`--resume` with a permission prompt tool, when no permission mode was set
Fixed the `Notification` hook not firing while the sandbox "Network request outside of sandbox" permission prompt is waiting
Fixed Bash permission checks to always require approval for malformed commands with a dangling `&&` or `||` operator
Fixed `--strict-mcp-config` sessions prompting to approve `.mcp.json` servers they would never load, which left background sessions waiting at startup
Fixed telemetry and metrics requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); a credential is now only sent to its own host
Fixed a visible API error on the first prompt after idle when `apiKeyHelper` returns short-lived JWTs: an expired cached token is now refreshed before sending, and 401/403 auth errors retry quietly
Fixed memory growing with session length in the fullscreen and Ctrl+O transcript views: each rendered message row no longer retains a full copy of the transcript-wide tool lookups
Fixed `/ultrareview` runs and cloud sessions launched at the same time from one repository (e.g. from several worktrees) sometimes starting with another launch's uncommitted changes
Fixed the task progress count (e.g. `3/5`) shown for background cloud sessions such as `/autofix-pr` occasionally missing a task
Fixed Remote Control sessions keeping their placeholder name in claude.ai and the Claude app until the second prompt; the auto-generated title now appears after the first prompt
Fixed MCP tools marked `requiresUserInteraction` still offering "Yes, and don't ask again" in their permission prompt; the option wrote an allow rule the tool then ignored
Fixed the self-hosted runner ending its live sessions or exiting when a work-poll response is malformed (e.g. an intercepting proxy's HTML page); it now retries the poll
Improved `/cd`: the new directory's project settings, hooks, `.mcp.json` servers (behind the usual approval prompt), skills, and agents now take effect right after the move instead of on `--resume`
Improved Bash tool latency on bash shells by replaying snapshot functions without a base64 subshell per function
Improved subagent results: a subagent that stops at its `maxTurns` limit now returns its output marked as partial, with a hint to continue it via `SendMessage`, instead of appearing finished
